title.original: EVICPRESS: Joint KV-Cache Compression and Eviction for Efficient LLM Serving
title.zh: EVICPRESS：联合KV缓存压缩和逐出以实现高效LLM服务
title.en: EVICPRESS: Joint KV-Cache Compression and Eviction for Efficient LLM Serving

inclusion_reason.zh: EVICPRESS 以统一效用和跨层放置器联合管理 KV 压缩与逐出，是独立于单一模型的缓存基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: EVICPRESS jointly manages KV compression and eviction through a common utility and cross-tier placer, providing model-independent cache infrastructure.

abstract.zh: EVICPRESS 不再分别处理 KV 缓存压缩与逐出，而是跨多级存储联合选择两者，以兼顾生成质量和平均时延。系统用统一效用函数评估所有上下文的压缩敏感度与放置收益。
abstract.en: EVICPRESS jointly chooses lossy KV compression and eviction across storage tiers rather than optimizing either in isolation. A shared utility objective balances generation quality against average delay across all active contexts.

problem.zh: 单独压缩或逐出会忽略二者对全局命中率、恢复时延和质量的联动影响，导致快层容量利用不佳或敏感上下文被过度压缩。
problem.en: Independent compression or eviction ignores their coupled effect on global hit rate, restore delay, and quality, wasting fast-tier capacity or over-compressing sensitive contexts.

approach.zh: 分析器周期性估计每个上下文在不同压缩/逐出配置下的质量与时延效用，快速启发式算法再按各层容量重新布置 KV 缓存。
approach.en: A profiler periodically scores compression–eviction choices for each context by quality and latency utility, then a fast heuristic rearranges KV state subject to tier capacities.

system_design.zh: EVICPRESS 由在线效用画像器、跨层放置优化器和执行压缩/迁移的缓存管理器组成；敏感上下文获得更保守压缩，低敏感缓存则让出快速层空间。
system_design.en: EVICPRESS consists of an online utility profiler, cross-tier placement optimizer, and cache manager that executes compression or movement, preserving conservative settings for quality-sensitive contexts.

key_results.zh: 跨多个数据集与模型的评测显示，该联合策略提高快速设备命中率并缩短 TTFT，同时维持与基线相当的生成质量。
key_results.en: Across several models and datasets, the joint policy is reported to improve fast-tier hit rate and TTFT while preserving generation quality comparable to baselines.

limitations.zh: 系统依赖持续画像来估计有损误差，画像成本与分布漂移可能影响决策；摘要未说明新任务或快速变化上下文的冷启动风险。
limitations.en: The policy relies on ongoing profiling of lossy error; profiling cost and distribution shift can distort utility estimates, and cold-start behavior on new tasks is not described.

models: five LLMs (names not stated in abstract)

metrics.name: TTFT speedup at equivalent generation quality

notes.zh: 模型/数据集数量、基线类型与 TTFT 结果来自官方摘要；模型名、设备层级和质量指标待全文审计。
notes.en: Model/dataset counts, baseline classes, and the TTFT result come from the official abstract; model names, device tiers, and quality metrics await full-text audit.
